name: anyweb
description: Fill a supported Express Entry profile on this computer up to the last review before submit, and optionally save a website login for reuse here.

interface.shortDescription: Fill a supported Express Entry profile locally, then stop before submit.
interface.longDescription: Use the anyweb plugin to fill a supported Express Entry profile in visible local Chrome up to the pre-submit review, save an explicitly approved website login for reuse on this computer, and Tell Jacky. Repair-claim checks remain available. It is not a general-purpose automation tool.
defaultPrompt: Fill my Express Entry profile from these applicant files up to the final review step on this computer.
Continue a supported website draft on this computer.
Save my website login for reuse on this computer.
Tell Jacky about an AnyWeb problem.
